name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 77.6 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.
entries.reference: Am nevoie de 3 bilete pentru mâine dimineață.

entries.source: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.
entries.reference: Suntem 5 persoane, inclusiv 2 copii.

entries.source: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: Numărul meu de telefon este 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.
entries.reference: Zborul durează 9 ore și 25 de minute.

entries.source: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.
entries.reference: Suntem 4 persoane și avem 6 valize.

entries.source: Room 214 is on the second floor.
entries.reference: Camera 214 este la etajul doi.

entries.source: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.
entries.reference: Am sosit pe 3 octombrie și plec pe 9 octombrie.

entries.source: What time does the museum open on Sundays?
entries.reference: La ce oră se deschide muzeul duminica?

entries.source: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.
entries.reference: Trenul meu pleacă la 18:45 de la peronul 7.

entries.source: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.
entries.reference: Ultimul autobuz pleacă la 23:30 în această seară.

entries.source: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.
entries.reference: Am o rezervare la ora 8 seara pentru 2 persoane.

entries.source: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?
entries.reference: Farmacia se deschide înainte de ora 9 dimineața?

entries.source: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.
entries.reference: Turul începe la 14:15 și durează 3 ore.

entries.source: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.
entries.reference: Micul dejun se servește între 6:30 și 10:00.

entries.source: How much is a double room for 3 nights?
entries.reference: Cât costă o cameră dublă pentru 3 nopți?

entries.source: This costs 45 euros, including tax.
entries.reference: Asta costă 45 de euro, inclusiv taxe.

entries.source: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?
entries.reference: Există reducere pentru 2 adulți și 1 copil?

entries.source: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.
entries.reference: Biletul costă 12,50 euro de persoană.

entries.source: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?
entries.reference: Pot plăti cei 78 de euro cu cardul?

entries.source: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?
entries.reference: Cât costă autobuzul spre aeroport pentru 2 persoane?

entries.source: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.
entries.reference: Meniul zilei costă 15 euro cu băutură inclusă.

entries.source: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.
entries.reference: Adresa este Calle Mayor 15, etajul trei.

entries.source: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.
entries.reference: Hotelul meu este pe Gran Vía 28, lângă metrou.

entries.source: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: Ambasada este pe Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.
entries.reference: Vă rog să notați adresa: numărul 42, apartamentul 5B.

entries.source: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.
entries.reference: Punctul de întâlnire este Plaza del Sol, poarta 3.

entries.source: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Este acesta drumul spre Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Where is the nearest bus stop?
entries.reference: Unde este cea mai apropiată stație de autobuz?

entries.source: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.
entries.reference: Virați la stânga la semafor, apoi mergeți drept 200 de metri.

entries.source: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?
entries.reference: Se poate ajunge pe jos de la gară la hotel?

entries.source: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?
entries.reference: Care linie merge la aeroport, linia 5 sau linia 8?

entries.source: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?
entries.reference: Scuzați-mă, acesta este locul 14A?

entries.source: How do I get to the old town from here?
entries.reference: Cum ajung în orașul vechi de aici?

entries.source: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.
entries.reference: Muzeul este la aproximativ 15 minute pe jos de piață.

entries.source: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.
entries.reference: Vă rog, chemați o ambulanță, cineva este inconștient.

entries.source: I have lost my passport and my wallet.
entries.reference: Mi-am pierdut pașaportul și portofelul.

entries.source: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
entries.reference: Unde este cel mai apropiat spital sau clinică?

entries.source: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?
entries.reference: Sunt alergic la arahide; acest fel de mâncare conține?

entries.source: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.
entries.reference: Cineva mi-a furat geanta cu 200 de euro înăuntru.

entries.source: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
entries.reference: Chemați poliția, vă rog. A avut loc un accident.
